title.en: Which building output cell should you compare?
title.zh: 建筑浇筑该对照哪一格输送量？

description.en: Compare the printed m³/h on the model, from Electric 20 at 8–10 m³/h up to Electric 80 and HBT8018 at 60 m³/h. Those cells are not a daily volume.
description.zh: 对照型号上印的 m³/h，从电动20的 8–10 m³/h 到电动80和 HBT8018 的 60 m³/h。这些格子不是日方量。

h1.en: Which building output cell should you compare?
h1.zh: 建筑浇筑该对照哪一格输送量？

directAnswer.en: Compare the theoretical output printed for that model, then stop. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists Electric 20 at 8–10 m³/h, Electric 30 and low-pressure 40 at 12–15 m³/h, Electric 40 at 21 m³/h, Electric 50 at 26 m³/h, low-pressure 60 at 35 m³/h, Electric 60 at 40 m³/h, HBT80-16 at 50 m³/h, and Electric 80 and HBT8018 at 60 m³/h. The construction page says to check delivery capacity against the pour. It does not publish a daily total.
directAnswer.zh: 对照该型号印出的理论输送量，然后停住。邢台河北品锦机械列出电动20为 8–10 m³/h，电动30和低压40为 12–15 m³/h，电动40为 21 m³/h，电动50为 26 m³/h，低压60为 35 m³/h，电动60为 40 m³/h，HBT80-16 为 50 m³/h，电动80和 HBT8018 为 60 m³/h。建筑页说按浇筑核对输送量。它没有公布日累计方量。

heading.en: A higher m³/h cell is a different machine
heading.zh: 更高的 m³/h 是另一台机器

body.en: Do not ask a 21 m³/h Electric 40 to carry a 60 m³/h description. Hopper size also changes: 0.25 m³ on Electric 20, 0.4 m³ on Electric 40 and Electric 50, 0.7 m³ on Electric 60 and Electric 80. The hopper cell is not a day’s production. It is the printed hopper volume.
body.zh: 不要让 21 m³/h 的电动40去承担 60 m³/h 的描述。料斗也在变：电动20是 0.25 m³，电动40和电动50是 0.4 m³，电动60和电动80是 0.7 m³。料斗格不是一天的产量，它是已印的料斗容积。

heading.en: Output without stone and distance is incomplete
heading.zh: 没有石子和距离的输送量是不完整的

body.en: Electric 50 keeps 26 m³/h across three stone rows while the metres change. Electric 80’s 60 m³/h sits with 900 m / 300 m and ≤ 2 cm stone. HBT8018’s 60 m³/h sits with 150 m conveying and 450 m delivery height and aggregate 4 cm and below. Same 60 m³/h, different distance tables.
body.zh: 电动50的 26 m³/h 横跨三行石子，米数却在变。电动80的 60 m³/h 配的是 900 m / 300 m 和 ≤ 2 cm 石子。HBT8018 的 60 m³/h 配的是输送 150 m、输送高度 450 m、骨料 4 cm 及以下。同是 60 m³/h，距离表不同。

heading.en: What should Xingtai receive with the inquiry?
heading.zh: 向邢台询盘要带上什么？

body.en: Send the output you need as m³/h, not as a daily total the catalogue does not print. Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue does not print.
body.zh: 请按 m³/h 发送需要的输送量，不要写成目录里没有的日累计。 请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。

question.en: Does the site guarantee the catalogue output on a floor?
question.zh: 网站保证楼层上能达到目录输送量吗？

answer.en: No. The cells are theoretical. Feed at the hopper, stone size and pipeline still have to sit inside the printed row.
answer.zh: 不保证。格子是理论值。料斗供料、石子和管路仍须落在已印的那一行里。

answer.en: Electric 80 and HBT8018. HBT80-16 prints 50 m³/h. Read the distance cells before treating them as one choice.
answer.zh: 电动80和 HBT8018。HBT80-16 印的是 50 m³/h。把它们当成一个选项之前先读距离格。

question.en: Is there a published daily volume for a building?
question.zh: 建筑有公布的日方量吗？

answer.en: No. Do not invent one in the inquiry.
answer.zh: 没有。询盘里不要编一个。
